source_anchor: CLRS §30 (Fibonacci recurrence F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2)); standard textbook iterative DP form
prompt_text: Compute the 10th Fibonacci number with the convention F(0)=0, F(1)=1. Print F(10). Expected output: "55".

exec_cell.code: function fib(n){if(n<2)return n; let a=0,b=1; for(let i=2;i<=n;i++){const t=a+b; a=b; b=t;} return b;} console.log(fib(10));

candidate_responses.text: CORRECT: tree-recursive form with the same F(0)=0, F(1)=1 base case.
candidate_responses.code: function fib(n){if(n<2)return n; return fib(n-1)+fib(n-2);} console.log(fib(10));

candidate_responses.text: WRONG: shifts the base case so F(0)=1, F(1)=1 — every value is offset by one position, producing F(11)=89 in place of F(10)=55.
candidate_responses.code: function fib(n){if(n<=1)return 1; let a=1,b=1; for(let i=2;i<=n;i++){const t=a+b; a=b; b=t;} return b;} console.log(fib(10));

candidate_responses.text: CARGO-CULT: prev/curr identifiers and accumulator-over-loop form, but never updates prev — curr=prev+curr just sums into itself.
candidate_responses.code: function fibonacci(n){let prev=0,curr=1; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){curr=prev+curr;} return curr;} console.log(fibonacci(10));
